about: Ind Bank Housing Ltd (IBHL), incorporated in 1991, is a BSE-listed subsidiary of Indian Bank. It stopped fresh lending in 2000; after RBI cancelled its housing-finance Certificate of Registration effective 21.09.2023, it ceased HFC /NBFC business and is now limited to recovering /disposal of legacy mortgaged assets and resolving related litigation.
